name: hdie_host_cprx_r1-r1-COMMIT
purpose: HBM die d4f host_cp receive tile (HBMA-HOST2 2026-10-17, coordinator 0dc+ (b)+(d)): host landing FIFO (2 real 256x256 SRAMs, abutted MY stack as landing r1) FOLDED with the static host packet controller; removes the 512-b landing->packet bus and the separate host_cp_packet tile. Packet RXREG=0 (no 512-b rx pin stage), regional reset relays (landing 1, packet 5 regions, +3 edges release). Lockstep-exact vs the separate closed pair (landing r1 + packet r1). Outline 246.24x194.4 = landing r1 slot.
